scope: Historical six-operator experience; documentation only; no GPU reruns

records.hypothesis: Reduce candidate searches and persist tuning choices while retaining full correctness/benchmark coverage.
records.observed_result: 54 cases and 24 benchmark comparison rows validated; private output tuner isolated from shared GLA tuners.
records.interpretation: Adopted for validated domains; full tuning path retained. Warm-cache speed is not cold compiler speed.
records.next_action: Complete the corrected empty-cache experiment before quantifying cold-start improvement.

records.hypothesis: Use only three representative cases/shapes as default to reduce acceptance time.
records.observed_result: Temporary tiers were removed; final default tests are 6+48 and benchmark has 12 shapes.
records.interpretation: Coverage reduction was not the requested final solution to slow tuning.

records.hypothesis: Check whether the approximately 10.16 percent cross-run slowdown reproduces under paired cached measurements.
records.observed_result: 12 paired cycles: median change +0.0524 percent; no cycle above the 5 percent screen.
records.interpretation: Historical signal not reproduced in this one workload. The screen is not a formal global acceptance threshold.
records.next_action: Use paired same-condition measurements for future suspected regressions.

records.hypothesis: Measure the full 54-test run with a new empty cache.
records.observed_result: Probe failed before GPU tests because get_cache_manager received a non-hex key. Helper CPU tests passed after a hex-digest fix.
records.interpretation: No successful cold C550 measurement yet; failed setup time is not an operator timing.
records.next_action: Run corrected probe and full suite with independently verified empty cache; preserve existing cache.

records.hypothesis: Retain exact builtin-int validation while resolving a lint diagnostic without changing semantics.
records.observed_result: One documented E721 exception, identical AST, 26 CPU type cases passed; final EOF blank line removed before commit.
records.interpretation: No global lint relaxation or GPU semantic change.
records.next_action: Keep exact source binding when reusing prior validation.

records.hypothesis: Distinguish existing formal Triton files from the optional EXP10A native experiment.
records.observed_result: Five formal files were already identical. Prototype validation separately passed 23 cases.
records.interpretation: Neither file equality nor prototype PASS alone constitutes production integration acceptance.
records.next_action: Use production and publication records for current release status.

records.hypothesis: Supply missing package build tools without replacing the validated runtime.
records.observed_result: Initial setuptools-scm metadata failure preceded compilation; isolated offline build tools enabled successful package validation.
records.interpretation: A packaging-environment failure, not evidence of a native math error.
records.next_action: Preserve runtime identity and verify wheel/sdist contents on future builds.

records.hypothesis: Integrate native acceleration for an explicit validated domain while retaining Triton fallback.
records.observed_result: 42 passed, 0 skipped; package/import validation passed; five HND paired shapes geomean speedup 1.9128x; source published.
records.interpretation: Scope-limited acceleration. Build, enablement and runtime validation remain environment-specific.
records.next_action: Do not extend acceleration claims to untested layouts/dtypes/devices.

records.hypothesis: Resolve all TLE incompatibility by changing six allocation layouts.
records.observed_result: Final accepted source instead checks required builder APIs and keeps only the sync-path layout override.
records.interpretation: Allocation layout alone does not supply missing asynchronous memdesc/MMA capabilities.

records.hypothesis: Use available synchronous TLE capability without replacing the global runtime.
records.observed_result: 14 passed, 13 expected skips out of 27; 0 failures/errors.
records.interpretation: Acceptance applies to executed cases; skipped domains remain unverified by this run.
records.next_action: Archive per-case skip reasons before claiming additional domains.

records.hypothesis: Wrap a four-element shape tuple as one x-axis argument.
records.observed_result: Argument unpacking was corrected but matplotlib later rejected tuple-to-float conversion.
records.interpretation: Intermediate driver fix was incomplete, not an operator correctness failure.
records.next_action: Use four numeric axes with a matching benchmark signature.

records.hypothesis: Preserve full platform API through the wrapper and expose valid numeric benchmark axes.
records.observed_result: Two-route smoke and 6-prefill/8-decode BF16 benchmark completed.
records.interpretation: Valid absolute measurements; no vLLM or cross-container speedup established.

records.hypothesis: Establish stable absolute latency across six sequence lengths.
records.observed_result: All six measured; T256/T1024/T2048 need targeted review, other three are ROBUST_STABLE.
records.interpretation: Process success is not equivalent to every measurement meeting stability criteria.
records.next_action: Repeat only review shapes under controlled load, retaining samples and drift statistics.

records.hypothesis: Explain a failed outer gate without discarding valid benchmark output.
records.observed_result: Only an accidental zero-byte untracked file named 9 was present; exact cleanup restored a clean tree.
records.interpretation: Repository-integrity and benchmark-process results must be recorded separately.
records.next_action: Keep lock/file-descriptor redirection separate from data output.

records.hypothesis: Record BF16 forward and backward absolute latency for eight shapes.
records.observed_result: Initial missing-parent mktemp failure was corrected; 16 benchmark rows completed.
records.interpretation: Measurement success only; independent-baseline speedup and full correctness counts are not established here.
records.next_action: Preserve shared GLA tuning state when consumers add private tuners.

records.hypothesis: Measure sparse attention and compression separately for two dtypes and seven shapes.
records.observed_result: 28 forward-only rows completed using 30 CUDA Event samples per measurement.
records.interpretation: No backward or end-to-end aggregate claim; no specific failed kernel experiment recorded.
records.next_action: Add full correctness and independent-baseline evidence before broader acceptance claims.

records.hypothesis: Equal Torch versions/device names are insufficient to establish compatible custom TLE runtimes.
records.observed_result: CYC GDN2 autotuning knob missing; WZB MiniMax builder capability incomplete.
records.interpretation: Audit actual module paths and capabilities; isolate fixes rather than globally swapping a working runtime.
records.next_action: Record runtime identity and route evidence for each future change.
